title: Fast teleport to exit no lagging at all
features:
Tweens you to a part called "ExitPart"

Uses TweenService for smooth movement

You can change the speed at the top

Works on any executor that supports TweenService

Doesn’t insta teleport, looks more natural

Can be used in obbys or exit systems

Clean and doesn’t lag

Easy to edit if you wanna use a different part
script:
local speed = 200 
local part = workspace.Map:WaitForChild("ExitPart") 


local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local destination = part.CFrame 
local distance = (destination.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
local duration = distance / speed

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local tween = TweenService:Create(hrp, tweenInfo, {CFrame = destination})
tween:Play()
